name: KromiumContextMenuListener
summary: Functional interface for intercepting, suppressing, or customizing right-click context menus.

methods.name: onBuildContextMenu
methods.description: Called when a context menu is about to be displayed.

parameters.name: builder
parameters.description: Declarative builder for adding, removing, or customizing menu items.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Click coordinates, target URLs, selected text, and helper actions.

companionMethods.name: disabled
companionMethods.description: Suppresses context menus entirely by clearing all items.

companionMethods.name: defaultMenu
companionMethods.description: Preserves default native context menu items without modifications.

companionMethods.name: devToolsOnly
companionMethods.description: Replaces default menus with a minimal developer menu containing only 'Inspect Element'.

companionMethods.name: minimalEditing
companionMethods.description: Turnkey menu tailored for clean desktop applications with copy, paste, select all, and optional inspect element.

parameters.name: includeInspectElement
parameters.description: Whether to include inspect element option.
